cohort: A total of 95 women participated in this prospective study and were divided into five groups based on disease status: healthy, normal biopsy, LSIL, HSIL, and cervical cancer.
finding: Cervical elastography, measured by ESD, can distinguish cervical cancer from normal cervical and preinvasive lesions, but it is unsuitable for determining preinvasive cervical lesions from a normal cervix.
